items.name: The Empress
items.effect: All hunters get faster stamina regeneration while it is active.
items.cardSummary: The Empress refills your team's stamina faster, so hunters can sprint and reposition more often during a job. It pairs well with Strength for sprint-heavy runs and applies to every hunter, not just the buyer.

items.name: The Chariot
items.effect: All hunters get a faster walk speed while it is active.
items.cardSummary: The Chariot raises walk speed for the whole team, helping hunters cover the map and escape ghosts faster. It is a cheap mobility option that benefits everyone on the job.

items.name: Strength
items.effect: All hunters get double stamina while it is active.
items.cardSummary: Strength doubles each hunter's stamina pool, letting the team sprint for far longer before slowing down. It is strong for evading ghosts and works best alongside The Empress for sustained mobility.

items.name: Temperance
items.cardSummary: Temperance adds two extra photo discards, giving the team more room to retake evidence photos without wasting attempts. It is the cheapest perk and unlocks early, making it an easy pick for photo-objective runs.

items.name: The Emperor
items.effect: All hunters get an extra inventory slot while it is active.
items.cardSummary: The Emperor gives every hunter an extra inventory slot, so the team can carry more gear into a job. It is a high-level unlock and is often recommended for loadout-heavy runs.

items.name: The Hanged Man
items.effect: Makes crosses burn twice while it is active.
items.cardSummary: The Hanged Man lets crosses burn twice instead of once, doubling that protection against hostile ghosts. It unlocks the earliest of any perk, making it an accessible defensive option for newer hunters.

items.name: Sun
items.effect: Makes Holy Oil burn twice while it is active.
items.cardSummary: Sun makes Holy Oil burn twice, extending the team's protection from that item during a hunt. It is a defensive choice for jobs where you rely on Holy Oil to hold off the ghost.
